title: El Mole de Atocpan, MEXI STORIES
comment: mole-atocpan (MEXI): cocina de mole de una casa en San Pedro Atocpan, Ciudad de México. Caras comunes, no famosas; los tres se distinguen a simple vista.

chars.XOCHITL_LUNA: Mexican woman from Mexico City, mole cook, 24 years old, brown skin, long black hair in two braids, a mustard-yellow blouse, a dark-red apron stained with mole, a long dark skirt, her hands empty.
chars.GONZALO_LUNA: Mexican man from Mexico City, 56 years old, stocky, light-brown skin, short grey hair, a grey mustache, a brown leather jacket over a white t-shirt, jeans, boots, his hands empty.
chars.MONICA_SALGADO: Mexican woman, 43 years old, light skin, wavy dyed caramel-blonde hair, red lipstick, a tight emerald-green satin blouse, white trousers, gold necklace, heels, holding a smartphone.

locs.LOC_COCINAMOLE: Traditional mole kitchen of a family house in San Pedro Atocpan, Mexico City, at dawn: a huge clay pot of dark mole on a wood fire, a stone metate with dried chiles, baskets of chiles, sesame and chocolate, tiled counters with blue Talavera tiles, a doorway to a small living room with a sofa, warm firelight, no readable text, no signs, no logos, no people.
